data.body: WIRING GAP from S3: runner.py does not yet call dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter. S3 rewrote the arbiter module/schema/tests. S4 must wire the cycle-end dispatch into runner.py — both at the max_cycles hard-cap path AND at the Jaccard stability halt signal. Without this, the arbiter is never triggered in production and end-to-end PR validation (required for epic closure per user) cannot be done. Add as a mandatory DD: 'runner.py calls dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter at cycle-end (both max_cycles and Jaccard-halt paths); verified by end-to-end PR review triggering the arbiter and returning BLOCK/DEFER/DROP decisions.'
